summary: Nuveen Farmland REIT subsidiary acquired two agricultural properties: ~146.2 acres in Illinois for $1,842,624 and ~3,339.1 acres in Mississippi for $18,783,000, both from IAI USA entities under separate purchase agreements dated September 24, 2026, totaling roughly $20.6M. Each deal closed concurrently with signing, funded by the REIT's continuous private offering. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or per-share pricing disclosed as these are asset-level purchases. Rule 3-14 financials and Article 11 pro formas are due within 71 days. Watch for 8-K/A financials and any further portfolio roll-up.
